# Gamma Pricing in 2026: Plans, Credits and Real Costs

Last checked: November 10, 2026. Gamma changes prices, credits and plan names without notice. The figures below come from published plan breakdowns, and they may not match Gamma's live page by the time you read this. Confirm every number at gamma.app/pricing before you pay.

## What Gamma pricing is in 2026

Gamma is an AI tool that generates presentations, documents and web pages from a prompt. It sells access through tiered subscriptions, and each tier combines three things: a price per seat, a pool of AI credits, and limits on how large one generation can be. The tiers are Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra and a Business plan for teams.

The decision you are making is rarely "which plan is cheapest." It is whether the entry paid tier covers your decks, or whether card limits and credits push you up a level. For a team, it is also what the seat count does to the total. Below is the plan grid, then each part explained, then one worked cost…

# Gamma Pricing 2026: Free vs Plus vs Pro and Credits Explained

**Disclosure:** This post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, Axel SEO earns a commission at no extra cost to you, and you get the discount shown.

## The short answer

**Gamma pricing has five self-serve tiers: Free (400 one-time credits that never refill), Plus (1,500 credits a month), Pro (4,000), Ultra (20,000) and Business ($40 per member per month, billed annually, 10,000 credits each). For a small business that sends a few proposals a month, Plus is usually enough. Agencies that publish sites on their own domain need Pro.**

Gamma shows the Plus, Pro and Ultra prices in your local currency at checkout, so the exact number depends on where you sign up and whether you pay monthly or yearly. Below we explain what each tier really buys, how fast credits go, and how to avoid paying for a plan you will not use.
